subject.title: [Feature]: Persistent active-agent + workspace indicator in Dashboard (multi-agent safety)

question: Should the Dashboard keep persistent active-agent and workspace context in the chat chrome, and should that land through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95346 or be folded into the newer chrome redesign?
rationale: Current source confirms the UX gap, but the correct permanent surface depends on the maintainer-owned header/sidebar direction now being changed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101017.

options.title: Preserve context and adapt the active fix
options.body: Keep persistent agent/workspace visibility as a safety requirement and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95346 or fold equivalent context into the final chrome design.

options.title: Fold into the chrome redesign first
options.body: Pause the focused fix until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101017 settles the topbar/sidebar layout, then require equivalent workspace context there before closing this issue.

options.title: Reject persistent header context
options.body: Close the feature direction only if maintainers decide the workspace rail and session controls are sufficient for multi-agent safety.

recommendation.title: Preserve context and adapt the active fix
recommendation.body: Keep persistent agent/workspace visibility as a safety requirement and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95346 or fold equivalent context into the final chrome design.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the recent Dashboard chrome redesign commit and is the clearest product-direction owner in the inspected history.
